provenance: Actual Electron renderer from out/renderer of the checkout this script ran in; synthetic services; no Codex or agent run
checks: trusted: under the Codex runtime row, "◐" and then "injected and trusted on 0.154.0; no event has arrived yet from a real session", then the sentence that the trust gate does not cover Codex; nothing clipped at 1440 or 560 px

observed: under the Codex runtime row, "✓" and then "observed on 0.154.0 — first event Sep 14, 2026, 9:04 PM", then the sentence that the trust gate does not cover Codex; nothing clipped at 1440 or 560 px

unavailable: under the Codex runtime row, "✕" and then "not available: Codex did not trust Wanigan's hooks by the hashes it reported", then the sentence that the trust gate does not cover Codex; nothing clipped at 1440 or 560 px
not yet asked: the line says it is checking, asks main once with the Codex profile id (never a path), and then shows the answer
a failed check reads "could not read" with the error, and is never drawn as trusted, observed or not available
